summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, containing a press release with its monthly delivery update for June 2026. The company reported delivering 30,895 vehicles, with cumulative deliveries reaching 1,733,687 as of June 30, 2026. The update also highlights the launch of the all-new Li L8 and provides operational metrics such as retail store count, servicing centers, and super charging stations. This filing is a routine operational update on vehicle deliveries and business activities, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. There are no deal terms or strategic corporate actions disclosed.
